record.question: What is a web cookie in the context of internet browsing?
options: Sent from a website and stored in user’s web browser while a user is browsing a website
Sent from user and stored in the server while a user is browsing a website
Sent from root server to all servers
Sent from the root server to other root servers
record.explanation: An HTTP server sets cookies in responses and the browser/user agent stores them and may return them in later requests. The option is the intended simplified description. Verified solution (unofficial); reviewed 26 October 2026. References: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc6265.html
